entries.source: Hope you are having a wonderful day!
Ask Grok to /learn from your past traces and tune Grok Build to how you work.
entries.translation: 让 Grok 通过 /learn 从你的过往记录中学习，使 Grok Build 更贴合你的工作方式。

entries.source: Grok Build now gets better the more you use it. It remembers conventions, decisions, and project facts across sessions. /memory to browse, /dream to organize. Start a new session to pick it up.
entries.translation: Grok Build 现在会越用越好。它能跨会话记住约定、决策和项目信息。使用 /memory 浏览，使用 /dream 整理。新建会话即可启用。

entries.source: A datacenter incident is affecting all Grok models. The team is investigating.
entries.translation: 数据中心事故正在影响所有 Grok 模型，团队正在调查。
